verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product like Fellow, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions choosing a storage region or data residency. The related privacy controls it does document (configurable retention policies, zero-day retention, Super Admin export/delete) are adjacent features and earn no credit for region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
